start: Money, Collections, This month, with receipts on screen

must_not: No file and no message
A toast with a different count than the file has rows

user_sees: Hindi names and the rupee sign read correctly
The Amount column adds up to the collected total on screen
must_not: Boxes or question marks in place of Hindi letters
A mobile number turned into 9.88E+09
A cancelled receipt inside the Amount total

start: Other reports with the same button: Your growth, Dues, Attendance, pass visits

steps.action: Open Money, "Dues", filter to one age group, tap "Download Excel file"
user_sees: Only the rows on screen in the file; toast "Exported <n> dues."

steps.action: Download the collections file and open it in Excel
user_sees: The name cell shows the typed text starting with an apostrophe guard, as plain text
must_not: A live link or formula in the cell
Excel asking to run or update something

steps.action: Filter the receipts list to nothing
must_not: An empty file saved

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the button

steps.action: Download, then clear the filter and download again
user_sees: Two files: the first with only that method, the second with all; each toast gives its own count
must_not: The second file still filtered
The browser keeping only one of two files with the same name without saying so

start: Any report file saved from the panel
